Name: Spider Retexture and Synchronization
Author: iiAsyra
Description:
Since I couldn't find any good retextures for spiders besides the base game spider sprites from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14359]DeonDF's Afraid of Monsters[/url], I decided to make my own. Credit to DeonDF for spider color and design inspiration.

Retextures:

-Base game spiders

-Vanilla style spiders from ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42168]Syanide's Animal Expansion

[/url]-﻿Pet spiders from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22547]JP's Le Pets - Monsters of the Mines

[/url]-Spider web trinket with the tiny spider on it from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29074]Mushymato's Sinister Servants

[/url]Since Sinister Servants actually uses the base game spider textures, the 4 sprite texture that includes 3 spider sprites and a death animation, the spider from Sinister Servants automatically changes as well, so I only had to retexture the trinket to match the spider textures.

This mod checks to see if you have Animal Expansion, Monsters of the Mines, and Sinister Servants ﻿installed before patching the image for those mods, but doesn't require them. So, technically, you could just use it to replace base game spiders, but I recommend their mods for maximum enjoyment, especially the pet one. There's two sleeping animations for the spider, and one is super cute :)

Downloads.Description: If you want to get the most out of this mod, please download the optional mods that this patches the textures for. If you just want the base game spider monsters to be retextured, then feel free to download this as a standalone mod.

Manifest.Name: Spider Retexture & Synchronization
Manifest.Description: Retextures the spider animals and recolors the produce from Syanide's Animal Expansion, retextures the spider pet from JP's Le Pets - Monsters of the Mine, retextures the spider trinket from Mushymato's Sinister Servants, and the base game spider, and synchronizes them together.
